AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Grants administrator privileges for the external Task Gullak Admin Panel.

adminId.description: The authenticated Firebase UID of the admin.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when admin role was granted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a Task Gullak user profile, wallet balance, reward metrics, and account ban status.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID owning this profile.

fullName.description: Display name of the user (1 to 100 characters).

email.description: Email address linked to the Task Gullak account.

completedTasksCount.description: Total number of verified/approved tasks completed by the user.

pendingRewards.description: Pending reward amount in INR (₹) awaiting admin verification.

emailVerified.description: Whether the user's email address has been verified.

isBanned.description: Optional flag controlled by the Admin Panel indicating whether the user is banned.

banReason.description: Optional reason provided by the Admin Panel when banning a user.

avatarId.description: Optional 3D avatar preset identifier selected by the user.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

TaskSubmission.title: TaskSubmission
TaskSubmission.description: Represents a user's task completion message, screenshot proof, and admin approval status.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID who submitted the task.

userName.description: Optional denormalized display name of the user for the Admin Panel.

userEmail.description: Optional denormalized email of the user for the Admin Panel.

taskId.description: Identifier of the project/task being completed.

category.description: Task category (e.g., Video, Feedback, Checklist, Survey, App Testing).

rewardAmount.description: Reward amount in INR (₹) for this task.

proofText.description: Completion message, feedback response, or verification notes submitted by the user.

screenshotBase64.description: Optional compressed Base64 data URI of the user's task completion screenshot proof.

status.description: Verification status of the submission controlled by the Admin Panel.

adminNote.description: Optional review note or rejection reason added by the Admin Panel.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

AdminTask.title: AdminTask
AdminTask.description: Represents an earnable task/project published or removed by the Admin Panel.

category.description: Category label (e.g., Video, Feedback, Checklist, Testing, App Install).

rewardInr.description: Reward amount in INR (₹) paid upon admin approval.

proofRequirement.description: Description of the completion message and screenshot proof required.

active.description: Whether the task is currently active and visible to users.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

BroadcastNotification.title: BroadcastNotification
BroadcastNotification.description: Represents a real-time push/in-app notification broadcast from the Admin Panel.

title.description: Notification title shown in the phone system notification and app tray.

targetUserId.description: Optional target ('all' for global broadcast or a specific user UID).

WalletTransaction.title: WalletTransaction
WalletTransaction.description: Represents a wallet credit or deduction entry created by Admin Panel actions or task approvals.

userId.description: The user UID whose wallet was credited or debited.

note.description: Description or reason for the credit/deduction.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores administrator UIDs authorized to operate the external Admin Panel.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated user's profile, Gullak wallet balance, and ban status.

/users/{userId}/submissions/{submissionI.description: Stores task submissions, completion messages, and screenshot proof for a specific user.

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Root-level mirror of task submissions enabling the Admin Panel to review, approve, and credit all user submissions.

/tasks/{taskId}.description: Stores projects and tasks added or removed by the Admin Panel.

/broadcasts/{broadcastId}.description: Stores real-time broadcast notifications pushed from the Admin Panel to user devices.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Stores wallet credit and deduction ledger records for a user.
